messages:
maria.design: quick design review — users keep confusing the timepicker with the sampling control. suggest we separate them visually and semantically.

dylan.ux: agree. propose a small button/chip to the right of the timepicker: 'Sampling: Auto'. opens a popover with Auto / 10% / 25% / 50% / 100%. include one-line helper: 'Auto adjusts for range; 100% returns exact p95.'

sam.eng: backend support ready. new param: sample=auto|0.1|0.25|0.5|1. example: GET /api/obs/latency?range=6h&sample=auto. server will return header X-Sampled: true when sample<1.

lina.pm: defaults: map Auto -> <15m:100%, 15m-6h:50%, 6h-24h:25%, >24h:10%. add microcopy: 'p95 may be estimated when sampling <100%'.

raj.product: add guardrail: if sampled p95 differs >15% from last full-run, show banner: 'Sampled p95 differs from full-run by X% — view full results'. track event obs_sampling_discrepancy.

eva.a11y: accessibility: popover must trap focus, keyboard operable, aria-live announce 'Chart updated, p95 estimated' when appropriate, and the estimated badge must have aria-describedby. check contrast for badges and selected options.

dylan.ux: visual changes: move percentile legend up, show p50/p95 first, then sampling state. add a tiny 'estimated' pill next to p95 when sample!=1. have compact and advanced toolbar variants.

maria.design: action items: dylan -> mocks (compact + advanced) by Wed EOD; sam -> API + X-Sampled header; eva -> a11y checklist and quick pass; lina -> finalize microcopy and acceptance; raj -> telemetry & threshold config. i'll create handoff doc after mocks. :thumbsup:
